data.body: **[P1] Preserve generation order after canceling a flush barrier.** `cancel_flush()` removes the boundary between generations. If the older generation has multiple records, this helper can then requeue its token behind the same ARN's newer-generation token. The worker discards that newer token due to the generation mismatch, allowing a subsequent flush to complete while the later—potentially terminal—record remains permanently pending. Requeue before any later-generation token for the same ARN (or merge generations when canceling), and add a timeout/recovery test with multiple pre-barrier records followed by a post-barrier record.
